budget_basis: Planned pre-run estimate, NOT a measurement. Assumes ~2.4M GPT-2 tokens in the WikiText-2 raw train split after upstream's group-into-blocks preprocessing (block_size=512), 1 epoch per generation, 11 generations. With human_data_alpha=1.0 the full human train split is appended to every recursive generation (src/train.py:548), so generations 1-10 consume ~4.8M tokens each and human tokens are consumed at every generation. The adapter records measured token totals from the executed run and expected_vs_observed.md must reconcile the two.

model.revision_policy: Upstream pins no revision (config/model/gpt2.yaml). The executing host must resolve and record the Hugging Face commit SHA; the adapter refuses to leave status=planned while this sentinel is unresolved.

data_selection.deviation_note: Overrides upstream's importance_sampling default. See PROTOCOL.md, 'Recorded deviation from the upstream default configuration'.

expected.ordering_note: This arm is expected to show the SMALLER degradation ratio of the two arms. The comparison itself is frozen in PROTOCOL.md, 'Frozen endpoint, ordering, and tolerance'.
